page.overview:
Who is Tower law?

Tower law is a set of decrees, laws, and statutes for governing the White Tower. As the Tower Guard is the military force of Tar Valon, they may be applied to the entire city-island.

Known laws of the White Tower at the current time:

This list tries to incorporate those features of a sitting which are laws. For a list that includes traditions see Hall of the Tower#Rules and Customs.

A sitting is a meeting of the sitters, Aes Sedai who have been elected, three from each Ajah, and form the governing body of the White Tower.
